name: TileFillParams
doc: Bounded flood fill of edge-connected cells matching the seed's tile.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: Inclusive minimum coordinate; bounds make empty-space fills finite.

fields.name: tile
fields.doc: New tile definition, zero to erase.

fields.name: autotile
fields.doc: Re-run terrain rules on the filled region and its border (default false).
